title: Celebrate Holi with ONIDA
strategy: This campaign focuses on celebrating the joyous festival of Holi, emphasizing the moments that families create together with ONIDA appliances. The idea is to showcase how ONIDA products can enhance the festive spirit and help save precious memories during family gatherings and celebrations.
